list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: Crystalline sodium–hydrogen salt of the Gd6 polyoxotungstate complex

source_locations.location: Main text, paragraph introducing salts 1a and 2a
Main text, structural discussion of 1a and Figs. 1 and 3

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: The discrete anion contains four B-α-AsW9O33 and two B-β-AsW9O33 trilacunary Keggin units linked by W3O13, W2O10 and WO6 fragments and W–O–Gd–O–W pathways. Its six Gd centers form a nonplanar ring; five are eight-coordinate and one is nine-coordinate. Acetate and oxo-containing units bridge adjacent Gd sites.

synthesis.procedure: A one-pot reaction of Na9[B-α-AsW9O33] with Gd(NO3)3·6H2O at a stated 1:3 mole ratio in 1 M NaOAc–AcOH buffer was heated at 50 °C for 30 min. The solution was cooled, a small precipitate was removed, and precipitating cations were added to the filtrate.
synthesis.time: 30 min heating; several weeks for crystallization
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: After cooling, a small precipitate was removed; precipitating cations were added to the filtrate, from which single crystals formed after several weeks.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: Microcrystalline sodium–ammonium–hydrogen salt of the Gd6 polyoxotungstate complex

properties.summary: The Gd(III) bulk sample shows nearly ideal Curie-type, spin-only susceptibility. Intramolecular exchange through Ln–O–W–O–Ln pathways is negligible.

source_locations.location: Main text, magnetic-susceptibility paragraph; Fig. S1 cited there
Main text, structural discussion of the shared anion 1; Figs. 1 and 3

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: This bulk salt contains anion 1, whose six Gd centers form a nonplanar ring within a discrete polyoxotungstate framework assembled from four B-α- and two B-β-AsW9O33 units plus smaller tungsten-oxide linkers. The detailed anion structure was established from crystalline salt 1a, not a separate crystal structure of 1b.

synthesis.procedure: A one-pot reaction of Na9[B-α-AsW9O33] with Gd(NO3)3·6H2O at a stated 1:3 mole ratio in 1 M NaOAc–AcOH buffer was heated at 50 °C for 30 min, cooled, and filtered to remove a small precipitate. Precipitating cations were added to the filtrate; the bulk salt was obtained as a microcrystalline sample.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Cooled and filtered; precipitating cations were added to the filtrate to obtain the microcrystalline bulk salt.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: Crystalline sodium–cesium–hydrogen salt of the Yb10 polyoxotungstate complex

source_locations.location: Main text, synthetic-routes paragraph and crystal-data note
Main text, structural discussion of 2a and Figs. 2 and 3

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: The discrete anion has inversion symmetry. Eight B-α-AsW9O33 fragments occupy the vertices of a distorted rectangular prism, joined by WO6, acetate-bridged W2O10 and AsO3 units and Yb–O–W links. Six Yb centers form an approximately planar magnetic-core ring; four additional Yb centers connect to that ring through O–W–O pathways. All Yb centers are eight-coordinate.

synthesis.procedure: A one-pot reaction of Na9[B-α-AsW9O33] with YbCl3·6H2O at a stated 1:3 mole ratio in 1 M NaOAc–AcOH buffer was heated at 50 °C for 30 min. The solution was cooled, a small precipitate was removed, and precipitating cations were added to the filtrate.
synthesis.time: 30 min heating; several weeks for crystallization
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: After cooling, a small precipitate was removed; precipitating cations were added to the filtrate, from which single crystals formed after several weeks.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: Microcrystalline sodium–cesium salt of the Yb10 polyoxotungstate complex

measurements.conditions: Approximately room temperature; variable-temperature susceptibility measured at 0.1 T over 2–290 K
measurements.name: χMT

properties.summary: The temperature dependence of χMT is attributed to thermal population of higher Yb(III) multiplet states rather than appreciable intramolecular exchange; a single-ion ligand-field model fits the data.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: This bulk salt contains anion 2, a decanuclear Yb polyoxotungstate with eight B-α-AsW9O33 units arranged at the vertices of a distorted rectangular prism. Six Yb centers form an approximately planar ring, and four others attach through O–W–O linkages. The detailed anion structure was established from crystalline salt 2a, not a separate crystal structure of 2b.

synthesis.procedure: A one-pot reaction of Na9[B-α-AsW9O33] with YbCl3·6H2O at a stated 1:3 mole ratio in 1 M NaOAc–AcOH buffer was heated at 50 °C for 30 min, cooled, and filtered to remove a small precipitate. Precipitating cations were added to the filtrate; the bulk salt was obtained as a microcrystalline sample.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Cooled and filtered; precipitating cations were added to the filtrate to obtain the microcrystalline bulk salt.
